title: CallLint Trust lookup index
description: The closed, client-facing lookup index (calllint.trust-lookup-index.v1, ADR 0055 §5). A deterministic projection of the baked Trust Index so a human can find the CallLint Trust Page for a real resource — no LLM, no fuzzy matching. Distinct from the API-side partner-api/src/lookup.ts. additionalProperties:false at both levels makes it structurally impossible to carry a score or any free-text/PII field; each entry is a lean projection of an already-public, immutable observation, so publishing it never changes a verdict, a page digest, the sidecar, or the index (ADR 0053 §3). Phase 2.4 (ADR 0056) adds the Safe-install linkage installUrl/contractUrl/installability: present (non-null) only when the resource also has a baked acquisition page, derived from the same canonical slug so a link can never 404; a resource with no install page carries all three as null. These are deterministic projections of already-public facts (a URL + the shipped verdict→route enum), never a score.
